_meta.purpose: document artifact: report.md authored via file_write/file_edit, exported through document_pdf, with open_for_print expectations. Files delivery mode. Exercises the document finalizer + PDF export oracle.

manifest.starter_kit_note: registry registers no starter_kit for document; this fixture references the proposed document_frame kit (GAP) only for the print layout shell. Not in kits/starter.py yet.

semantic_metadata.note: Markdown carries no DOM, so data-disco-* anchors apply at the PRINT-RENDER layer (the HTML the PDF pipeline produces). Comment anchors map review notes to source spans.

attributes.source: reviewer note anchored to a report.md span

tweak_metadata.note: document kind has no registered TweakSpec; documents are edited via file_edit on report.md. Empty by design.

evidence_host_must_observe: report.md exists and is non-empty markdown
document renders to a print layout (open_for_print) with headings/sections resolved
cited metrics resolve to a source_ref in the resource_manifest (no orphan figures)
print render shows visible content (not a blank page)

open_for_print.expectation: host opens the rendered document in a print-ready view before PDF export; pagination + page size applied

known_invalid_variants.name: missing_report_md
known_invalid_variants.mutation: no report.md at project root (only an exported PDF present)
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: ready_for_document_verification rejects: required file report.md missing

known_invalid_variants.name: empty_report
known_invalid_variants.mutation: report.md exists but is empty / whitespace only
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: document finalizer rejects: print render shows blank page, fails visible-content evidence

known_invalid_variants.name: zero_byte_pdf
known_invalid_variants.mutation: document_pdf deliver stage emits a 0-byte report.pdf
known_invalid_variants.expected_failure: document_pdf validate/deliver rejects: export output must be bytes>0 (DeliverableEvent bytes check)
